title: Rammeavtale elektromateriell
description: Oppdragsgiver forvalter flere kirker, gravplasser og øvrige eiendommer, noe som medfører at oppdragsgiver har et løpende behov for elektromateriell til drift og vedlikehold. Oppdragsgiver skal inngå en rammeavtale med én leverandør, og formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at Bergen kirkelige fellesråd får dekket sitt samlede behov for elektromateriell på en effektiv og hensiktsmessig måte. Ved større prosjekter vil oppdragsgiver forespørre leverandør om prosjektpriser, hvor også tilkjøring og levering vil være en viktig del av oppdraget.Oppdragsgiver har i dag en tilsvarende rammeavtale med Onninen som utløper januar 2027. Forventet oppstart på denne rammeavtalen er derfor januar 2027. Avtalen inngås for en periode på to (2) år fra signeringsdato. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon til å forlenge avtalen med ett (1) år av gangen, i inntil to (2) ganger. Maksimal samlet avtaleperiode er fire (4) år. Opsjoner utløses ved skriftlig beskjed av oppdragsgiver minimum tre (3) måneder før utløp. Avtalen opphører automatisk ved utløp av avtaleperioden. Dersom alle opsjoner benyttes er anskaffelsens forventede totalverdi kr. 10 000 000, med et årlig forventede uttak på kr. 2 5000 000. Maksimal kontraktsverdi er kr. 15 000 000. Summen er beregnet på historiske data.

title: Výstavba dostupného bydlení ve Vesničce soužití
description: Tato veřejná zakázka na stavební práce je vzhledem k předpokládané hodnotě plnění veřejné zakázky zadávána formou otevřeného podlimitního řízení podle § 56 zákona. Zakázka není rozdělena na části ve smyslu § 35 a § 101 zákona. Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zhotovení díla v rozsahu stanoveném touto zadávací dokumentací. Předmětem díla je zejména provedení a obstarání veškerých prací potřebných k dokončení výše uvedené veřejné zakázky a jejímu úspěšnému předání zadavateli. Veškerá plnění a práce související se splněním díla zabezpečí zhotovitel na svůj náklad. Hlavním cílem projektu je novostavba souboru staveb, které řeší dokončení a dostavbu obytné zóny „Vesničky soužití“ v k.ú. Ostrava Muglinov, městské části Slezská Ostrava, který zajišťuje Diecézní charita ostravsko-opavská. Obytná zóna byla již z větší části realizována cca před 20-ti lety a z finančních důvodů nebyla dokončena. Soubor navrhovaných staveb se dělí na stavební objekty 18 řadových rodinných domů ve dvou řadách (E a F, které navazují na stávající řady C a D) a jednotlivé projekty souboru zajišťující jejich připojení na dopravní a technickou infrastrukturu. Napojení bude realizováno na předem připravené inženýrské sítě a komunikace, které byly provedeny při předchozí stavební etapě. Podrobná specifikace stavby je uvedena v příloze č. 1 – Obchodní podmínky, v příloze č. 4 – Soupis stavebních prací, dodávek a služeb a v příloze č. 5 – Projektová dokumentace zadávací dokumentace. Veškeré aktivity projektu musí být realizovány v souladu s cíli a zásadami udržitelného rozvoje a zásadou „významně nepoškozovat“ (dále jen „DNSH“) v oblasti životního prostředí. Veřejná zakázka probíhá v rámci projektu „Výstavba dostupného bydlení ve Vesničce soužití“ předloženého ke spolufinancování z Integrovaného regionálního operačního programu (dále též „IROP“), 115. výzva IROP, SOCIÁLNÍ BYDLENÍ II KPSV + – SC 4.2 (MRR), registrační číslo projektu: CZ.06.04.02/00/24_115/0007124.

title: Germany – Construction work for water projects – ThAi.3002 - Tiefbauarbeiten für Deichrückverlegung und Flutmulde
description: 1. Deichrückverlegung Aicha (DRV): • Neubau eines zonierten Hochwasserschutzdeiches in Erdbauweise (Länge ca. 2,7 km, Höhe ca. 1,5 bis 6 m) bestehend aus Zone 1 (nicht bindiges, kalkhaltiges Deckenlagenmaterial, ca. 52.900 m³), Zone 2 (nicht bindiger Stützkörper, ca. 85.700 m³) und Zone 3 (bindige Deichbasis aus Eigenmaterial, ca. 53.600 m³). • Herstellung einer Deichinnendichtung in Deichachse bis ca.14,5 m Tiefe, nach Wahl des AN (Dichtwand oder Spundwand, Fläche der Deichinnendichtung ca. 21.600 m²). • Wegebauarbeiten zur Herstellung des asphaltierten Deichhinterwegs (Breite 3,5 m), des Deichkronenwegs als Schotterrasen (Breite 3m), Deichüberfahrten (5 Stück) sowie verschiedener Rampen und Anschlüsse an das vorhandene Wegenetz. • Begleitende Landschaftsbauarbeiten wie Oberboden-, Ansaat- und Mähearbeiten, inkl. Sodenumsetzung aus dem bestehenden Deich Aicha in die DRV (siehe auch Punkt 2). 2. Rückbau des bestehenden Deichs Aicha: • Rückbau des Stützkörpers des Bestanddeichs Süd über eine Länge von ca. 1,7 km inkl. Materialgewinnung für den Deichneubau (ca. 12.200 m ³ bindiges Material aus der Oberflächenabdichtung und ca. 30.600 m³ aus dem kiesigem Stützkörper). • Übertragen des Oberbodens auf die neue DRV, teilweise als Sode. • Rekultivierung der ehemalige Deichaufstandsfläche (ca. 18.400 m²) 3. Temporäre Querdeich: • Herstellung eines ca. 300 m langen Querdeichs aus Lieferkies (ca. 13.900 m³) mit landseitigem Dränfilter aus Schotter 5/56 zur Aufrechterhaltung des Hochwasserschutzes während der Bauzeit. 4. Umlegung Graben Aicha 1: • Herstellung einer ca. 1,2 km lange Grabenverrohrung DN 1000 mit 17 Schächten DN 1500 (Tiefe bis ca. 5,3 m) im Leitungsgraben mit Verbau. • Zum Bau der Grabenverrohrung begleitende Bauwasserhaltung mit Pumpensümpfen, Drainagerohren DN 300, Sammelleitungen und zweistufigen Sandfängen. Stark grundwasserabhängige Baubedingungen mit vorgegebener Bereichspriorisierung und Umsetzkriterien. • Verfüllung der Leitungszone mit Flüssigboden aus Eigenmaterial des Flutmuldenaushubs (siehe Punkt 5). • Herstellung eines ca. 400 m langen offenen Grabenabschnittes (Tiefe bis ca. 2,0 m) 5. Flutmulde Thundorf: • Herstellung einer ca. 2,6 km lange Flutmulde als Trapezgerinne (Sohlbreite ca. 40 m, Böschungsneigungen 1:3) durch Erdaushub bis ca. 2 m Tiefe (Aushub nach Oberbodenabtrag ca. 78.700 m³). Verwendung des bindigen Aushubmaterials teilweise zur Herstellung der Deichbasis der DRV Aicha (ca. 41.400 m³) und des Flüssigbodens für die Grabenverrohrung (ca. 3.000 m³). Entsorgung von Überschussmaterial (ca. 34.300 m³). • Herstellung eines Wegenetzes aus Grünwegen in der Flutmulde (ca. 3 km). • Herstellung eines Rechteckdurchlasses (1,3 m × 0,85 m, ca. 13 m lang) im Bereich der Flutmulde • Begleitende Landschaftsbauarbeiten wie Oberboden-, Ansaat- und Mähearbeiten. -- Besondere Randbedingungen : • Zeitliche Einschränkung der Bautätigkeit in relevanten Baubereiche der Flutmulde, der DRV und des Bestanddeichs im Rahmen der Einhaltung von Bauzeitenregelung zum Schutz verschiedene Tierarten. • Aufrechterhaltung des Hochwasserschutzes während der Bauzeit • Witterungs- und grundwasserabhängige Baubedingungen bei der Herstellung der Grabenverrohrung und der Flutmulde.

title: Spain – Technical assistance services – SERVICIO DE MANTENIMIENTO Y CONSERVACIÓN DE LAS PRESAS E INFRAESTRUCTURAS DE ADUCCIÓN, BOMBEO, TRANSPORTE Y DISTRIBUCIÓN DE AGUA BRUTA EN EL ÁMBITO DE LAS CUENCAS MEDITERRÁNEAS ANDALUZAS EN LAS PROVINCIAS DE CÁDIZ Y MÁLAGA. 2027 – 2029.
description: La Demarcación Hidrográfica de la Cuencas Mediterráneas Andaluzas en el territorio comprendido dentro de las provincias de Cádiz y Málaga cuenta con una serie de infraestructuras hidráulicas que conforman su patrimonio hidráulico, las cuales son de titularidad de la Junta de Andalucía y están gestionadas desde la supervisión y coordinación de la Dirección General de Infraestructuras del Agua. Estas infraestructuras de transporte y distribución de agua bruta necesitan un mantenimiento constante para asegurar su funcionalidad, siendo sin duda, una arteria vital para la economía de las dos provincias al abastecer no solo a la gran mayoría de la población, sino también a áreas estratégicas como lo es la producción agraria, así como usos industriales, actuar para laminación de avenidas y garantizar el régimen de caudales ecológicos aguas abajo de las infraestructuras de regulación. Es por ello fundamental el disponer de un sistema de mantenimiento, conservación y reparación de estas infraestructuras, pues un fallo de estas, en lugares sensibles, podría producir unos daños extremadamente graves llegando incluso a colapsar áreas de la economía de estas provincias, desabastecer de agua potable a la población o no preservar el cumplimiento de los objetivos ambientales de la planificación hidrológica. Conforme con lo establecido en el artículo 4 del Decreto del Presidente 6/2024, de 29 de julio, sobre reestructuración de Consejerías: “Corresponden a la Consejería de Agricultura, Pesca, Agua y Desarrollo Rural las competencias que actualmente tiene atribuidas, así como las hasta ahora ejercidas por la Consejería de Sostenibilidad, Medio Ambiente y Economía Azul en materia de uso, gestión y conservación sostenible de los recursos marinos .” Según lo establecido en el artículo 15 del Decreto 157/2022, de 9 de agosto, por el que se establece la estructura orgánica de la Consejería de Agricultura, Pesca, Agua y Desarrollo Rural, modificado por el Decreto 165/2024, de 26 de agosto, corresponden a la Dirección General de Infraestructuras del Agua la planificación, programación, supervisión y seguimiento de la explotación y de los programas de mantenimiento y conservación de las obras hidráulicas adscritas a los sistemas de explotación de competencia autonómica, la aprobación de los documentos relativos a la explotación y seguridad de presas, embalses y balsas de agua, según las definiciones del artículo 357 del Reglamento del Dominio Público Hidráulico, aprobado por el Real Decreto 849/1986, de 11 de abril, de titularidad de la Comunidad Autónoma de Andalucía, así como la aprobación de sus planes de explotación.

The work includes the provision of routine and periodic cleaning services, as well as any additional cleaning required to meet operational needs. Services must be provided in accordance with the specifications outlined in this Statement of Work and must support a clean, safe, and professional environment at all times, while not interfering with the daily operations or activities of the building’s occupants, clients, or visitors. Description of the Requirement: The objective of this engagement is to enable the organization to successfully adopt and sustain the changes introduced by DFO digital investments as well as the overall transformation agenda for the department. The Change Management resources will focus on the people's side of change, ensuring employees understand, accept, and embrace new technologies, processes, and ways of working. This includes minimizing resistance, building stakeholder commitment, and fostering a culture that supports continuous improvement and innovation. In addition, the Change Management resources must establish, document, and continuously improve change management standards, frameworks, methodologies, tools, and governance practices to promote a consistent and scalable approach across all digital initiatives. They will be responsible for ensuring the consistent application of these standards across projects, programs, and business areas, enabling a cohesive and enterprise-wide approach to change adoption and transformation. The Change Management resources will also be expected to build internal organizational capability by training, coaching, mentoring, and supporting employees, leaders, project teams, and emerging change management practitioners. This includes transferring knowledge, developing practical change management competencies, and helping establish a sustainable community of practice that strengthens the department's long-term ability to lead and manage change independently. Security: There are security requirements associated with this requirement. Please note that SA Holders do not need to have the required clearance to submit a bid. For additional information, consult Part 6 - Security, Financial and Other Requirements, and Part 7 – Resulting Contract Clauses. For more information on personnel and organization security screening or security clauses, Bidders should refer to the Contract Security Program of Public Works and Government Services Canada (http://www.tpsgc-pwgsc.gc.ca/esc-src/introduction-eng.html) website. Level of Security Requirement: Security Requirement: Common PS SRCL #6 applies Minimum Corporate Security Required: Designated Organization Screening (DOS) Minimum Resource Security Required: RELIABLITY Document Safeguarding Security Level Required: Not applicable Special comments: Applicable Trade Agreements: World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-AGP), the Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA), the Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA), the Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (CColFTA), the Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement (CPanFTA), the Canada-Honduras Free-Trade Agreement, the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement (CUFTA), the Agreement on Trade Continuity between Canada and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement (CKFTA). Proposed period of contract: The proposed period of contract shall be from Contract award to two (2) years later. The scope of work includes, but is not limited to, the demolition and removal of the existing electrical infrastructure and the supply and installation of a complete new electrical system in accordance with the contract drawings, specifications, and all applicable codes and standards. The Contractor shall be responsible for implementing and maintaining all required environmental protection measures and health and safety procedures throughout the duration of the project, in strict compliance with the contract specifications, drawings, and applicable regulatory requirements. The Contractor must perform and complete the work under this project within (16) weeks of contract award.

title: Collection Management System for AAFC national living biological collections under the Service as a Software (SaaS) model
description: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) will acquire and implement a software as a service (SaaS) Collection Management System (CMS) software solution specifically developed for managing and supporting biological living collections. The Collection Management System must support the capture and management of data, transactions and protocols for multiple organism collection types; helping to administer the curation and maintenance of living microbial collections including viruses, fungi, and viruses and fungi hosted in living plants. The period of the contract will be from the date of issue for a period of 3 years with a further option for 2 years after the initial 3 years.

title: Silmälääkärin vastaanottopalvelut yhteishankintana Pirkanmaan ja Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialueille
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen ja Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen silmälääkärin vastaanottopalveluiden hankinnan tarjouskilpailuun. Hankinnan kohteena ovat Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen ja Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialueen järjestämisvelvollisuuden piiriin kuuluvat silmälääkärin vastaanottopalvelut erikoislääkärin vastaanotolle ohjatuille lapsi- ja aikuispotilaille. Palvelua hankitaan täydentämään Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen ja Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialueen omaa palvelutuotantoa. Palvelut toteutetaan Palveluntuottajan omistamissa tai muulla tavoin hallinnoimissa tiloissa. Hankinta on jaettu osa-alueisiin seuraavasti: * Osa-alue 1. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue: Silmätautien erikoislääkärin vastaanottopalvelut aikuisille * Osa-alue 2. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue: Silmätautien erikoislääkärin vastaanottopalvelut lapsille * Osa-alue 3. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue: Reumalasten uveiittiseulonnat * Osa-alue 4. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue: Karsastus- ja amblyopialasten hoito * Osa-alue 5. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue: Optiotuote: YAG- laserointi * Osa-alue 6. Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue: Silmätautien erikoislääkärin vastaanottopalvelut aikuisille * Osa-alue 7. Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue: Silmätautien erikoislääkärin vastaanottopalvelut lapsille * Osa-alue 8. Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue: Reumalasten uveiittiseulonnat * Osa-alue 9. Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue: Karsastus- ja amblyopialasten hoito * Osa-alue 10. Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialue: Optiotuote: YAG- laserointi Sopimuskaudet alkavat seuraavasti: * Osa-alueen 4. osalta sopimuskausi alkaa 1.4.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. * Osa-alueen 9. osalta sopimuskausi alkaa viimeistään 1.4.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. * Muiden osa-alueiden osalta sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialuetta koskevien osa-alueiden osalta ennakoidut volyymit on kuvattu kunkin osa-alueen osalta kohdassa "Osan kuvaus". Ennakoidun volyymin arvioimiseen on käytetty Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen kilpailutettavan palvelun aikaisempien vuosien osto-/ asiakasmääriä. Hankintasopimuksen perusteella tehtävien tilausten määrät vaihtelevat sopimuskaudella Tilaajakohtaisen tarpeen mukaan, eikä hankintasopimus sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta. title: Finland – Construction consultancy services – Infrahankkeiden hankintapalvelu 2027–2030, Eteläinen hankinta-alue (Puitesopimus)
description: Tilaaja muodostaa infrahankkeiden (tie- ja siltahankkeet sekä päällysteet) hankintapalveluihin urakoiden suunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen ja valvontaan puitejärjestelyn, johon valitaan puitesopimustoimittajat. Hankintapalveluun kuuluvat urakoiden valmistelu, urakka-asiakirjojen laadinta, urakoiden kilpailuttaminen, toteutuksen aikainen toiminta ja valvonta (mukaan lukien turvallisuuskoordinaattorina toimiminen), takuuajan toiminta ja näihin liittyvät avustavat tehtävät sekä toteuttamissopimusten laadinta ja seuranta. Tehtävät määritellään aina erikseen toimeksiantokohtaisesti. Hankintamallit ovat mm. kokonaisurakka sekä ST- ja käyttöikämallit eri variaatioineen. Puitesopimuksella voidaan teettää myös erittelemättömiä rakennuttamiseen liittyviä hankinta-asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankintapalvelu on jaettu kolmeen sopimusosaan, tiehankkeille, siltahankkeille ja päällystehankkeille tehdään eri sopimukset. Tarjoaja voi antaa tarjouksen kaikkiin tai vain yhteen näistä. Puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kuusi (6) puitesopimustoimittajaa kullekin sopimusosalle, ellei tarjoajien soveltuvuutta koskevia vaatimuksia täyttäviä tarjoajia tai hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia ole vähemmän. Tehtävän sisältö on määritetty tarkemmin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Puitesopimuksen (tie/silta/päällysteet) voimassaoloaikana yksittäisten toimeksiantojen osalta rahoittajana voi olla myös Kaakkois-Suomen elinvoimakeskuksen (Kymenlaakso, Etelä-Karjala, Päijät-Häme) ja Uudenmaan elinvoimakeskuksen alueen (Uusimaa) kunnat.

title: Netherlands – Payroll management services – Salarisadministratie en AFAS Payroll Services
description: Met deze Europese aanbesteding beoogt de ODMH een deskundige en betrouwbare salarisverwerker te contracteren voor het uitvoeren van de salarisadministratie (payroll) voor alle medewerkers van ODMH. De leverancier is verantwoordelijk voor het volledig en juist verwerken van alle salarismutaties, het verzorgen van de salarisruns en het genereren van alle bijbehorende overzichten en (digitale) documenten ten behoeve van medewerkers, HR en Financiën. De feitelijke uitbetaling van salarissen en andere geldstromen blijft de verantwoordelijkheid van ODMH. De dienstverlening vindt plaats binnen de te implementeren AFAS ERP omgeving van de ODMH. De Opdrachtnemer is verantwoordelijk voor het tijdig en correct doorvoeren van cao-wijzigingen, fiscale wijzigingen en relevante wet- en regelgeving in de publieke sector in de AFAS-omgeving. 300.000

title: Finland – Translation services – Kielenhuoltopalvelut Työterveyslaitokselle
description: Työterveyslaitoksella on tarve hankkia kielenhuoltopalveluita. Tilaaja hankkii palveluita, koskien seuraavia osa-alueita: 1) Videoiden tekstitys- ja käännöspalvelut, hankinnan arvo n. 40 000 € neljässä vuodessa 2) Kirjallisten töiden käännös- ja kielenhuoltopalvelut, hankinnan arvo n. 200 000 € neljässä vuodessa 3) Äänitiedostojen litterointi, hankinnan arvo n. 40 000 € neljässä vuodessa Puitejärjestelyn puitesopimusten yhteenlaskettu ennakoitu kokonaisarvo koko sopimuskaudelta on 280 000 € (ilman arvonlisäveroa). Videoiden tekstitys- ja käännöspalvelut sekä Kirjallisten töiden käännös- ja kielenhuoltopalvelut -osa-alueille valitaan yksi toimittaja. Äänitiedostojen litteroijatoimittajaksi on tavoitteena valita kaksi toimittajaa. Puitesopimus on voimassa enintään neljä vuotta (1+1+2). Sopimus on ensin voimassa vuoden allekirjoittamisesta lukien. Tämän jälkeen sopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa ensin vuoden ja tämän jälkeen vielä kahden vuoden mittaisella optiolla. Tilaaja ilmoittaa option käyttöönotosta vähintään kolme kuukautta (3 kk) ennen sopimuskauden päättymistä. Tarjousten vertailu suoritetaan hintalomakkeella ilmoitettujen hintojen perusteella. Vertailussa käytetään tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevan hintalomakkeen mukaisesti laskettua vertailuhintaa. Halvimman vertailuhinnan antanut tarjous voittaa tarjouskilpailun.

title: Netherlands – Presents and rewards – EA cadeaukaarten t.b.v. DJI, de IND, JIO en het NFI
description: De scope van de aanbesteding: De aanbesteding heeft betrekking op de levering van één keuze-cadeaukaart ten behoeve van de deelnemende organisaties. De keuze-cadeaukaart wordt ingezet voor verschillende waarderingsmomenten, waaronder eindejaarsgeschenken, jubilea en bijzondere prestaties. De behoefte van Aanbestedende Dienst gaat uit naar één breed inzetbare keuze-cadeaukaart met landelijke dekking, welke fysiek geaccepteerd wordt bij acceptanten in Nederland en kan worden omgewisseld voor andere cadeaukaarten. De ingewisselde cadeaukaarten dienen fysiek en/of digitaal besteedbaar te zijn.

title: Finland – Food, beverages, tobacco and related products – Elintarvikkeiden hankinta: kasviproteiinit ja kuivat elintarvikkeet
description: Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö / tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia elintarvikkeiden ja muiden tarvikkeiden hankinnasta vuosille 2027 - 2029 tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Lisäksi tilaaja varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen optiovuoteen 2030-2031. Optiolla tarkoitetaan mahdollisuutta sopimuksen jatkamiseen alkuperäisin ehdoin. Optioiden käytöstä ja kestosta päätetään erikseen. Tavoitteena on, että sopimuskausi alkaa helmikuussa 2027. Hankinta on yhteishankinta, jossa ovat mukana Salon kaupunki ja Salon palvelutalosäätiö sr. Hankinnan kohteena ovat elintarvikkeet kaupungin ravitsemispalvelujen käyttöön. Ravitsemispalvelut valmistaa noin 8 500 ateriaa päivässä kaupungin eri yksiköille, pääsääntöisesti päiväkodeille ja kouluille. Kyseiset elintarvikkeet tulevat pääsääntöisesti suurkeittiöiden käyttöön eli pakkauskoot ovat suurkeittiökokoja.

title: Germany – Urban planning services – Zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Wettbewerb nach RPW 2013 - Produktives Quartier Gutleut-West
description: Gegenstand des Wettbewerbes ist ein städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Entwurf in dem gezeigt wird, wie die Transformation eines gewerblich geprägten Bestandsareals zu einem nutzungsgemischten, klimaangepassten und gemeinwohlorientierten Quartier gelingen kann. In einer Stadt mit hoher Flächennachfrage und begrenzten innerstädtischen Entwicklungsreserven treffen hier Ansprüche unmittelbar aufeinander, die sich andernorts oft räumlich aus dem Weg gehen: Wohnen und Gewerbe, Logistik und Aufenthalt, soziale Infrastruktur und Produktion, Freiraum und Verdichtung. Die entscheidende Frage lautet deshalb nicht, welche Nutzung sich am Ende durchsetzt. Interessanter ist, wie aus dieser Konkurrenz ein Stück Stadt entstehen kann. Das Gutleut-West ist kein isoliertes Entwicklungsprojekt, sondern ein Baustein der Frankfurter Innen-entwicklung – und ein Ort, an dem sich exemplarisch zeigen soll, wie produktive, gerechte und grüne Stadtentwicklung im Bestand gelingen kann. Mainufer und Sommerhoffpark gehören zu den besonderen räumlichen Potenzialen des Gebiets. Ihre Qualitäten sollen aufgegriffen und mit neuen Freiräumen und Wegen zu einem zusammen-hängenden Freiraumgerüst weiterentwickelt werden, das Aufenthalt ermöglicht, das Quartier verbindet und zugleich auf Hitze, Starkregen und ökologische Anforderungen reagiert. Die Verbindung unterschiedlicher Nutzungen und Anforderungen auf begrenzter Fläche ist genau die Aufgabe, auf die das Förderprogramm „Multifunktional und flächensparsam: Das Wohnquartier von morgen“ des Landes Hessen zielt. Gutleut-West wird darin als Modellprojekt unterstützt. Gefragt ist eine Entwicklung, die vorhandene Flächen und Strukturen besser nutzt, unterschiedliche Funktionen verbindet und zusätzliche Flächeninanspruchnahme vermeidet – ohne den gewerblich geprägten Charakter des Standorts einfach gegen eine neue Nutzung auszutauschen. Aufgabe des Wettbewerbs ist es, eine eigene räumliche Antwort zu entwickeln. Gesucht wird vornehmlich nicht das möglichst vollständige Bild eines irgendwann „fertigen“ Gutleut-West. Gesucht wird vielmehr ein städtebauliches und freiraumplanerisches Gerüst, das Orientierung gibt, ohne Entwicklung einzuschränken. Es soll durch zu entwickelnde Prinzipien Qualitäten sichern und zugleich Spielräume eröffnen – für unterschiedliche Nutzungen, Träger:innen, Eigentümer:innen und Entwicklungszeitpunkte. Darin liegt auch die Bedeutung der Prinzipien. Ein Quartier, das sich über lange Zeiträume entwickeln soll, braucht mehr als einen überzeugenden Lageplan. Es braucht Prinzipien, die auch dann noch tragen, wenn einzelne Gebäude anders genutzt, Baufelder durch andere Akteure entwickelt oder Entscheidungen zu unterschiedlichen Zeitpunkten getroffen werden. Die beiden Wettbewerbsphasen nähern sich dieser Aufgabe aus unterschiedlicher Entfernung: Phase I richtet den Blick auf das große Ganze. Zu entwickeln ist das städtebaulich-freiraumplanerische Gerüst: die räumliche Struktur, die Logik der Nutzungsmischung, Freiraum und Mobilität sowie eine schlüssige Vorstellung der etappenweisen Entwicklung. Es soll erkennbar werden, welche Setzungen die Idee tragen und wo bewusst Spielraum bleibt. Phase II stellt dieses Gerüst auf die Probe. Im Vertiefungsbereich Mainufer sowie anhand exemplarischer Gebäude- und Nutzungstypologien und des Vertiefungsprojekts im Potenzial-bereich Hafen wird das in Phase I entwickelte Gerüst unter konkreteren räumlichen und funktionalen Bedingungen überprüft, präzisiert und, wo erforderlich, ergänzt. Dabei werden insbesondere die Übergänge zwischen Wohnen und Gewerbe, das Verhältnis von Gebäude und Freiraum sowie Fragen von Erschließung und Logistik vertieft. Zugleich ist aufzuzeigen, dass die Lösungen unter unterschiedlichen Nutzungs- und Entwicklungsbedingungen tragfähig und umsetzbar sind. Der vorgeschaltete Offene Teilnahmewettbewerb mit einer Skizzenbewerbung als Reduktionskriterium öffnet den Denkraum. Mit den Phasen I und II des Wettbewerbs beginnt die räumliche Entwurfsarbeit. Auf Grundlage des ausgewählten Wettbewerbsergebnisses werden im Anschluss ein Rahmenplan mit integrierter Freiraumplanung für das Wettbewerbsgebiet sowie ein Qualitätshandbuch für das Gutleut-West erarbeitet. Darin werden die im Wettbewerb entwickelten räumlichen Setzungen, Prinzipien und Spielräume konkretisiert und als belastbare Grundlage für die weitere Entwicklung des Quartiers sowie für die anschließenden Konzeptverfahren für die städtischen Grundstücke gesichert. Die auslobende Stelle stellt eine Wettbewerbssumme in Höhe von insgesamt 240.000,00 Euro (netto) zur Verfügung. Folgende Aufteilung für Preise und Anerkennungen ist vorgesehen: 1. Preis: 66.000,00 Euro; 2. Preis: 41.250,00 Euro; 3. Preis: 24.750,00 Euro; Eine Anerkennung 33.000,00 Euro. Die Aufteilung der Wettbewerbssumme (Preise, Anerkennungen und Aufwandsentschädigungen) kann durch einstimmigen Beschluss des Preisgerichts neu festgelegt werden. Die ausgelobte Wettbewerbssumme ist dabei auszuschöpfen. Mit dieser Zahlung erlöschen alle Rechtsansprüche bezüglich Honorarforderungen der Teilnehmenden gegenüber der Bauherrschaft für die in dem Wettbewerb zu erbringenden Leistungen. Teilnehmende mit Geschäftssitz in Deutschland erhalten das Preisgeld zzgl. aktuell gültiger Mehrwertsteuer. Ausländische Büros erhalten das Preisgeld und die Aufwandsentschädigung netto. Insgesamt wird eine Summe von 75.000,00 Euro für Aufwandsentschädigungen vorgesehen. Jedes Büro, das eine wertbare Arbeit einreicht, erhält nach Abschluss der Phase I eine Aufwandsentschädigung in Höhe von 5.000,00 Euro (netto), sofern alle 15 Teilnehmenden eine wertbare Arbeit einreichen. Als wertbare Arbeit werden Arbeiten angesehen, welche das Preisgericht zur Beurteilung zulässt. Sofern weniger Arbeiten eingereicht werden, wird die Gesamtsumme auf alle eingereichten Arbeiten zu gleichen Anteilen neu verteilt.

title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE - ICE Data Indices, LLC � BAML Bond Index Family Subscription Services
description: INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE ICE Data Indices LLC SS-OFR-27-009 The Treasury Common Services Center (TCSC), on behalf of the Office of Financial Research (OFR) and the Financial Stability Oversight Council (FSOC), intends to make an award to ICE Data Indices LLC, 5660 New Northside Dr, 3rd Floor, Atlanta, GA 30328-5800, on a sole source basis, under authority of FAR 5.303 (a)(2) and FAR 13.101(b) for the purchase of BAML Bond Index Family Index Data Services which is currently provided by the vendor. There is no competitive vendor or regulatory agency that provides these datasets. The proposed Contractor developed and owns the propriety and patented software, algorithms, and work efforts that are used in these products and support the services specifically required for this acquisition; thereby, the proposed source has the sole unique technical and other resources required for this acquisition. The OFR is tasked to produce information on the current infrastructure of the global bond market in support of the Financial Stability Monitor and the FSOC Annual reports. OFR has been acquiring this data through sole awards to ICE since 2019. The BAML Bond Index Family Index Data Services consists of 7,000 standard indices tracking over $71 trillion in fixed income securities in the following markets: sovereign debt markets, global and regional (including US) investment grade markets, global high yield bonds, global emerging markets, and miscellaneous bonds such as par coupon, zero coupon, inflation linked swaps, deposit rates and spot currency indices. It is the largest known collection of bond indices available. Top level data is made publicly available to analysts. Constituent data is available for a fee per entity (government agency, corporation, etc.). Direct constituent data is the financial characteristics of the bond sectors and individual bonds and which make up an individual bond index. Projected changes in index characteristics and projected constituents are published monthly, and the indices are rebalanced every month. Critically required and available from this vendor is access to constituent level data for each bond which enables OFR to conduct the broadest research on the impact of bond market perturbations on market stability. This level of analysis would not be possible without constituent level data from each index. Furthermore, the vendor�s website permits: the viewing and/or download of the index and constituent database, setup of automated data feeds, creation of custom monitors, charts and analyses with automatic updates, use of the asset allocation model to create optimization updates, the viewing or download of global government, swap, and corporate yield curves, access to index rules and index publications, comparison model portfolios versus the index, and access the Rating Migration Databook. Historical data is required from at least 1996 for research on individual corporate borrowers, with daily pricing information, including dealer quotes, allowing for decomposition of price index fluctuations based on underlying constituents using OFR managed databases. The OFR Director and senior management require access to the individual sectors, in depth down to the constituent level, to meet periodic data and research requests. NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE. A request for more information, or a copy of the solicitation, will not be considered an affirmative response to this Special Notice. Telephone responses or inquiries to this Special Notice will NOT be accepted. Treasury Common Services Center will consider written responses received no later than 10:00 AM EST December 09, 2026. Responses must be submitted electronically to TCSC Acquisition Services TCSCAcquisitionServices@treasury.gov Attn: DA/KZ REF SS-OFR-27-009. Vendor responses must include sufficient evidence that clearly shows the proposed service is capable of meeting all the characteristics of the services needed and described above. If no written response is received that clearly demonstrates an ability to meet all requirements and is received by the aforementioned deadline, TCSC shall make award on a sole source basis to ICE Data Indices LLC. Qualified contractors must provide the following: The name and location of your company, contact information, and identify your business size and socioeconomic category (Large Business, Small Business, Disadvantaged Business, 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, HUBZone, etc.). Please ensure contact information includes the name of the point of contact, email address, and telephone number should the Government have questions regarding individual responses. Whether your service is available through an existing Government Contract Vehicle or Open Market. A narrative description of how your proposal meets all the characteristics needed for the service. A brief capabilities statement (not to exceed 5 pages) that includes a description of your company's standard line of business, as well as a list of customers your company currently provides these products/services for. UEI Number. The following file extensions are not allowable and application materials/data submitted with these extensions cannot be considered: .bat, .cmd, .com, .exe, .pif, .rar, .scr, .vbs, .hta, .cpl, and .zip files. Microsoft Office compatible documents are acceptable. No other information regarding this Special Notice will be provided at this time. title: Y1DZ--PN: 568A4-24-210, CON Renovate TR Houses in {HS/PR} FY27 NRM - VISN Base IFB Sealed Bid
description: This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a request for submission of bids. THIS IS A TOTAL 100% SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (SDVOSB) SET-ASIDE. In accordance with Public Law 109-461 and RFO VAAR DEVIATIONS 819.7003 (b), bidders must be registered and certified in the SBA certification database at (https://search.certifications.sba.gov/) as a SDVOSB. Only bids from verified SDVOSB s in the SBA certification database at the time of bid submission shall be deemed responsive. All non-responsive bids shall be rejected and ineligible for award. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with the applicable small business size standard of $45.0 million. In accordance with RFO VAAR DEVIATIONS 819.7003(b), the bidders must represent to the Contracting Officer that it is a small business concern under the NAICS code assigned to this acquisition. The magnitude of construction for this project is between $1,000,000 and $2,000,000. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Central Iowa Health Care System (VACIHCS) Des Moines Campus intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) in accordance with the procedures set forth in Part 14 and 36 of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO). Network Contracting Office 23 (NCO23) intends to award a single, firm fixed-price contract for completion of construction Project Number: 636A6-26-102, Replace Bldg 2 Condensate Leak at the VACIHCS Des Moines Campus, Iowa. An IFB is planned to be issued on or after Wednesday, May 6, 2026, with an award date within 75 calendar days from bid opening date. Further details of all dates, events, and locations, including a pre-bid site visit and bid due date, will be available in the solicitation. Base Bid: Contractor to provide all labor, equipment, materials and supervision necessary to complete Project Number: 568A4-24-210, CON Renovate TR Houses in, at the VA Black Hills Health Care System (VABHHCS) - Hot Springs Campus, in accordance with the attached drawings, specifications, and Statement of Work. The project includes renovations at two Transitional Residence (TR) House: Hot Springs, SD and Pine Ridge. At the Hot Springs VA Medical Center, the TR house is located in Building 29, which consists of approximately 3,600 SF of finished space with an additional 1,800 SF of basement space; renovations there will include restoration of the exterior siding and architectural finishes, interior updates to modernize the building, ADA compliance upgrades, and full replacement of the HVAC system. At Pine Ridge, a standalone 3,926 SF building of which approximately 2,400 SF is used as a TR House, renovations will include replacement of the roof, gutter system, downspouts, and exterior steel doors, along with new finishes in the TR House space such as cabinetry, bathroom remodeling, and full renovation of all resident rooms. Period of Performance for this work is 365 Calendar Days from issuance of Notice to Proceed (NTP). The IFB (solicitation), consisting of various bid documents, specifications, drawings, forms, etc. will be available for download at System for Award Management (SAM) Contract Opportunity (https://sam.gov/content/opportunities). The Contract Opportunities website is the only official location to obtain solicitation information and documents. These documents will include complete details of the solicitation and project requirements. Any amendments to the solicitation will be posted at the same location. Interested bidders are advised they are responsible for obtaining all bidding documents via Contract Opportunities, and for monitoring the Contract Opportunities website for any changes to this announcement and pending solicitation. No other information regarding scope, dates, etc. is available until issuance of the solicitation via Contract Opportunities. A bidders list will not be maintained. Hard copies of any documents regarding this project will not be mailed or made available outside of this website.

title: Narrow Linewidth Titanium-Sapphire Tunable Laser System
description: Notice from the United States Air Force, Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Installation Contracting Division, Base Support Contracting Branch at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB), Ohio: The AFLCMC Operational Contracting Branch, Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio is seeking capabilities packages of potential sources including Small Businesses (SB). This sources sought synopsis is published for market research purposes only, to identify potential sources capable of providing a Narrow Linewidth Titanium-Sapphire Tunable Laser System with the capabilities described herein for the Air Force Institute of Technology (AFIT) located at Wright Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio (WPAFB). The Government is seeking capabilities packages from all potential sources, including but not limited to: small business (SB), 8(a) participants, HUBZone Small Business, Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) and Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). Firms that respond shall review the attached instructions and technical requirements and submit responses that: Specify that offered products meet the specifications provided below; and Provide detailed information to show clear technical compliance. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS/QUOTES. All interested firms shall submit a response to the Primary Points of Contact, 2d Lt Arlyn Argueta at arlyn.argueta.1@us.af.mil, and Candice Snow at candice.snow@us.af.mil, demonstrating their capability to provide the Narrow Linewidth Titanium-Sapphire Tunable Laser System, stipulated in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.201, responses to this notice are not considered offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. A solicitation for this requirement does not exist, therefore, do not request a copy of the solicitation. The decision to solicit for a contract will be solely within the Government's discretion. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this acquisition is 334516 (Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing) with a small business size standard of 1,000 employees. Firms responding should indicate socio-economic status (8(a) with Graduation Date, SDVOSB, EDWOSB, WOSB, small business, and/or HUBZone). Respondents are further requested to indicate their status as a foreign-owned/foreign-controlled firm and any contemplated use of foreign national employees on this effort. The Government reserves the right to consider a small business set-aside based upon responses hereto for any subsequent action. All prospective contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database to be awarded a Department of Defense (DoD) contract. A small business set-aside decision has not yet been made. Respondents should note the potential application of Limitations on Subcontracting (FAR 52.219-14) and the Non-Manufacturer Rule (FAR 52.219-33) to a future acquisition that may result from this Sources Sought. Respondents should consider how the primary tasks identified in this notice will be broken out between prime contractor and subcontractors and address subcontracting in their response, if applicable/necessary. Any information submitted by respondents to this Sources Sought is voluntary. This Sources Sought notice is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government reimburse any costs associated with the submission of information in response to this notice. Respondents will not be individually notified of the results of any Government assessments. The Government's assessment of the capability statements received will factor into whether any forthcoming solicitation will be conducted as a full and open competition or as a set-aside for small business or any particular small business program. CAPABILITIES PACKAGE: All interested firms shall submit a capabilities package to provide Narrow Linewidth Titanium-Sapphire Tunable Laser System that explicitly demonstrates their capability to provide the required products. The capabilities package should be brief and concise yet clearly demonstrate an ability to meet the stated requirements. However, the response must not exceed five (5) pages. Capabilities Packages submitted in response to this sources sought synopsis must be received at the following e-mail addresses NO LATER THAN 28 OCTOBER 2026 AT 12:00 PM EASTERN TIME. All correspondence sent via email shall contain a subject line that reads: �Sources Sought - Narrow Linewidth Titanium-Sapphire Tunable Laser System�. If this subject line is not included, the email may not get through email filters at WPAFB. Filters are designed to delete emails without a subject or with a suspicious subject or attachments. Attachments with files ending in .zip or .exe are not allowable and will be deleted. Ensure only .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xlsx or .xls documents are attached to your email. All other attachments may be deleted. Responses shall be submitted via email to the following addresses: arlyn.argueta.1@us.af.mil and candice.snow@us.af.mil Please direct all questions concerning this acquisition to 2d Lt Arlyn Argueta at arlyn.argueta.1@us.af.mil and include the necessary subject line indicated above. Attachments: Instructions Statement of Work (SOW)

title: NSWC-PHD MATAC OTA Special Notice: MK41 Vertical Launching System - Super ATE
description: NSWC PHD requires a Super ATE solution that consolidates, to the maximum extent practicable, the functions of multiple existing or planned ATE systems into a common, modular, and scalable platform. The objective is to reduce the number of ATE assets required for LSEQ and MCP production; decrease laboratory and production-test footprint; improve test repeatability; reduce setup time; and simplify calibration, maintenance, configuration management, and lifecycle support. NSWC PHD requires Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to support production acceptance testing of MK 41 Vertical Launch System (VLS) Launch Sequencer (LSEQ) and Motor Control Panel (MCP) assemblies, including line-replaceable units (LRUs) within those assemblies. Currently, conducting lifecycle maintenance and testing requires utilizing multiple disparate pieces of test equipment, which creates a large footprint and increases operational complexity. The Government requires an innovative, integrated production-test capability that can consolidate multiple ATE functions into a common Super ATE architecture. The required capability must support complete-box testing, LRU-level testing, acceptance testing, and support for shock and vibration test requirements. Organizations interested in responding to this RFS must be members of MATAC. Visit MATAC.org for more information.

title: NSWC-PHD MATAC OTA Special Notice: MK 341 ITS Advanced Missile Integration
description: The Navy desires the development and integration of a unified MK 341 Interface Test Set (ITS) prototype capable of testing all current and emerging VLS missile variants. This prototype will consolidate the legacy MK 683 and predecessor MK 341 functionalities into a single advanced platform by FY2029. Accelerating the integration of emerging U.S. and FMS missile capabilities, while systematically mitigating obsolescence within the existing MK 341 ITS platform, requires leveraging existing MK41 VLS infrastructure and equipment. To support these compressed timelines, the project prioritizes rapid developmental cycles, direct access to secure government networks, and agile testing methodologies which are most e�ectively delivered through an embedded, collaborative engineering model. The contractor shall conduct all prototype design, development, and integration activities comprehensively on-site at the NSWC Port Hueneme Division (PHD) facility. Furthermore, upon successful completion of the prototype, the contractor will directly execute the fielding of the modernized system to the Fleet. The Government will provide one (1) legacy MK 341 ITS unit to serve as the baseline. The contractor shall utilize this unit to analyze the current system design, identify obsolescence, and develop the integration architecture for the new U.S. and FMS missile variants. Organizations interested in responding to this RFS must be members of MATAC. Visit MATAC.org for more information.

title: Department of the Army Criminal Investigation Division (DACID) Proactive Threat Platforms
description: DACID requires an advanced, cloud-hosted commercial threat intelligence and investigative software platform that bypasses the limitations of legacy, keyword-based Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tools by leveraging automated behavioral analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. The service must deliver a unified, secure digital environment that dynamically tracks threat actors across decentralized, darknet, and encrypted ecosystems; automatically decodes highly coded sub-cultural slang and memetic extremist iconography; resolves fragmented online monikers and metadata back to single real-world targets; and provides zero-trust managed attribution virtual environments for undercover operations, all while capturing disappearing digital evidence in a forensically sound, court-admissible format. Please see attachment 'DACID RFI SAM_09 NOV2026' for guidance.

title: S208-- Synopsis—Sole-Source SDVOSB Award for Bridge Grounds Maintenance services
description: Synopsis Sole-Source SDVOSB Award Grounds Maintenance Services The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to award a sole-source, firm-fixed-price Bridge Contract to a verified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), pursuant to 38 U.S.C. § 8127(c) and 48 CFR § 819.7008. The anticipated award is for ground maintenance services at Camp Butler National Cemetery. The contractor will provide all labor, supervision, equipment, tools, materials, transportation, and other resources necessary to perform grounds maintenance services in accordance with the performance work statement. Services are anticipated to include, but are not limited to: Mowing, edging, trimming, and maintenance of turf areas; Grounds cleanup and removal of leaves, branches, and other debris; Pruning and maintenance of shrubs, trees, and ornamental plantings; Weed control and maintenance of landscaped areas; Maintenance of beds, walkways, medians, and other exterior grounds; Pond Maintenance: Provide/apply algae & weed treatment. Provide pond equipment & equipment maintenance. Seasonal grounds services, as applicable; and Irrigation Winterization (Fall). The anticipated period of performance is March 1, 2027, through February 28, 2028. The place of performance is Camp Butler National Cemetery, 5063 Camp Butler, Springfield IL 62707. The applicable NAICS code is 561730, Landscaping Services, with a small-business size standard of $9.5 million in average annual receipts. The applicable Product Service Code is S208, Housekeeping Landscaping/Groundskeeping. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority cited above because the contractor has been determined to be the only verified SDVOSB reasonably available to meet the Government s requirements. The determination is based on the contractor s demonstrated capability, current site-specific knowledge, availability of required equipment and personnel, continuity of essential services, geographic capability, and ability to meet the required performance schedule. The Government will not pay for information submitted in response to this notice. Interested concerns may identify their interest and capability by submitting a capability statement no later than December 9, 2026, at 12:00pm EST to olalekan.ismail@va.gov Responses should include: Company name, address, telephone number, and point of contact; Unique Entity Identifier and CAGE code; Verification of current SDVOSB eligibility through the applicable VA verification system; Applicable NAICS code and size status; Relevant experience performing grounds maintenance services of similar size, scope, and complexity; Availability of the personnel, equipment, and resources necessary to perform the requirement; and Any information demonstrating that the requirement can be met in accordance with the performance work statement and required schedule. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. However, information received before the deadline will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to proceed with the contemplated sole-source award or whether a competitive procurement is warranted. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer.

title: SATMO Aviation Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 5.201 and 5.203, the U.S. Army Contracting Command - Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG), Orlando Division, on behalf of the U.S. Army Security Assistance Training Management Organization (USASATMO), intends to issue a competitive Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Aviation Training Support Services (ATSS) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to form, prepare, deploy, sustain, and redeploy Aviation Security Assistance Teams (SATs) worldwide in support of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) cases and Theater Security Cooperation Programs. Services are divided into two primary functional categories: (1) Training-Related Services and (2) Technical Assistance-Related Services. Required capabilities include tactical flight instruction, maintenance test flight operations, aircraft servicing, maintenance, armament, and operational planning on both Standard U.S. Military Aircraft (e.g., AH-64D/E Apache) and Non-Standard Rotary-Wing and Fixed-Wing Aircraft (e.g., Mi-17, Bell 407/412, Cessna 208). All maintenance, armament, and instruction must maintain U.S. Army airworthiness standards and comply with the Golden Sentry End-Use Monitoring (EUM) program.

description: Pre-Solicitation Notice/Synopsis SPE603-27-R-5015 GOVERNMENT-OWNED, CONTRACTOR-OPERATED (GOCO) FUEL STORAGE SERVICES AT MALMSTROM AIR FORCE BASE, MT and FE WARREN AIR FORCE BASE, WY Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy will be issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for fuels operations and management to include bulk storage services, retail service station support, alongside aircraft services, and entire fuels management services at two Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities, Malmstrom Air Force Base (AFB), MT and FE Warren AFB, WY. DLA Energy intends to issue one RFP for the two locations and award a separate contract for each location. DLA Energy intends to issue the RFP under full and open competition after exclusion of sources and the requirements will be 100% set aside for Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) under NAICS code 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage) in accordance with FAR 19.14. Firms submitting a proposal under this RFP must be certified as SDVOSB by the Small Business Administration in accordance with FAR 19.1403. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense-Wide Working Capital Fund (DWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statements (PWS) tasks. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for fuel products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, inventory accuracy, and no environmental impact. The Contractor is responsible for staffing, operations, maintenance, safety, security, environmental protection, training, contractor-furnished items, and Contractor Detailed Plans related to the fuels operations at the location. DLA Energy anticipates awarding two firm fixed-price contracts. The resultant contracts will include a four-year base period of performance with one five-year option in accordance with FAR 52.217-9. Additionally, an optional extension period not to exceed six months in accordance with FAR 52.217-8 will be included in the RFP. Interested firms may submit proposals for one location or both locations. DLA Energy anticipates issuing the RFP on January 18, 2027. The RFP will close about 40 days after posting. The RFP will be published electronically on the System for Award Management (SAM) website at https://sam.gov. Interested companies responding to the RFP are required to register in SAM prior to submitting a proposal. This is not an RFP or a promise by the Government to pay for information received in response to this synopsis or any subsequent announcement. This information is subject to modification and in no way binds the Government to award a contract.

title: Modification to Increase the Maximum Ordering Value of Contract Number 80GSFC23CA052 for the NASA GSFC Repairs, Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering (ROME) Contract
description: This is a Sources Sought notice to allow interested parties an opportunity to respond to this action. This is not a solicitation for proposals or quotes. No solicitation document exists at this time. This notice is being posted in accordance with NASA procurement transparency requirements to inform interested parties of the planned contract modification. NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) is providing notice of a planned modification to increase the maximum ordering value of Contract Number 80GSFC23CA052 for the NASA GSFC Repairs, Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering (ROME) contract. The contract is currently held by ASRC Federal Facilities Logistics, LLC. BACKGROUND: The ROME contract is an Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract which provides comprehensive facility operations, maintenance, engineering, construction, and technical support services for GSFC facilities and the NASA Kennedy Space Center (KSC) Wallops Flight Facility (WFF) and the U.S. Navy tenant at WFF. The contract utilizes a hybrid structure with Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) for operations and maintenance (O&M) services and Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) for design and construction task orders. The contract period of performance ends on September 14, 2028. JUSTIFICATION FOR VALUE INCREASE: The value increase is primarily driven by GSFC's Center Transformation and Consolidation initiative, which involves consolidating operations currently located west of Goddard Road into facilities on the east side of the Center. The original contract value did not account for the magnitude of construction and renovation activities required to support this effort. The consolidation initiative requires: Modifications to existing facilities Infrastructure upgrades Preparation of spaces to accommodate relocated operations Renovation and reconfiguration of east-side facilities to accommodate personnel and operations from the west side To date, more than 1,000 task orders have been issued under the ROME contract, with many additional requirements remaining. The cumulative value of these requirements represents a significant expansion of the construction workload beyond what was anticipated when the contract was originally awarded. URGENCY: Additional ordering capacity is urgently needed to execute the remaining consolidation requirements and to continue sustaining essential baseline O&M services through the existing contract end date. Without this increase, GSFC and WFF would not be able to continue baseline services, which would jeopardize critical facility operations supported by baseline O&M services and interrupt continuity of Center operations. Additionally, GSFC and WFF would be unable to award planned construction task orders, which would: Delay the relocation of operations and vacancy of west-side facilities Postpone realization of anticipated cost savings from consolidation Prolong the expense of maintaining aging infrastructure Potentially increase construction costs due to delays No extension to the period of performance is requested. The value increase will ensure continuity of essential services while allowing the Center to execute the remaining consolidation requirements within the existing ROME contract period of performance. The modification will be processed as a bilateral modification to the existing contract. Increasing the contract value does not itself obligate funds; individual task orders remain subject to funding availability and approval in accordance with established procedures. Responses must be submitted within the response period of this notice. Responses submitted after the response period will not be reviewed. Responses shall be directed to Carol Wooten, Contracting Officer, via email at carol.r.wooten@nasa.gov.

title: S--BIA Electrical Utility O&M Services
description: Sources Sought Notice: Skilled Electrical Utility Operations and Maintenance Services Agency: Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA), Western Region Anticipated PSC: S112, Utilities-Electric Anticipated NAICS: 238210, Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors Disclaimer: This Sources Sought Notice and RFI is issued for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. This is not a solicitation, request for proposal, or request for quotation. The Government is not obligated to award a contract or reimburse any costs associated with responding to this notice. The Government intends to use responses to assess industry capabilities, socioeconomic participation, acquisition strategy, and overall market conditions. Purpose: The BIA is conducting market research to identify qualified firms capable of providing skilled personnel and related support for electrical utility operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, testing, metering, and emergency restoration. The Government is particularly interested in responses from Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) and Indian Economic Enterprises (IEEs). Responses from other small businesses and qualified firms with relevant experience are also requested. Consistent with the Buy Indian Act and applicable regulations, this market research will assist the Government in determining the availability of qualified ISBEEs and IEEs and developing the acquisition strategy. See Attachment 1, Requirement Summary, for a high-level description of the anticipated services. Information Requested: Interested firms are requested to submit a capability statement that includes: Company Information: Company name, UEI, CAGE code, business size, socioeconomic status, and point-of-contact information. Firms claiming ISBEE or IEE status should clearly identify that status in their response. Relevant Experience: Describe similar work completed or performed within the past three years. For each example, identify the customer, scope, location, period of performance, approximate value, and whether your firm performed as the prime contractor or subcontractor. Technical Capability: Describe your firm�s experience supporting electrical utility systems; maintenance and repair operations; metering services; substation support; emergency response operations; and remote or geographically dispersed service areas. Identify the geographic service areas your firm can support and whether your firm can support all three BIA organizations. Safety Record: Provide a brief overview of the firm�s safety program and its most recent Total Recordable Incident Rate, if available. Industry Feedback Requested: The Government seeks industry recommendations regarding: � Contract type, Pricing structure � Single-award versus multiple-award approaches � Ordering methods for routine and emergency work � Appropriate NAICS and PSC codes � Methods to maximize ISBEE and IEE participation � Potential barriers to competition � Other recommendations concerning labor standards, staffing, mobilization, licensing, performance periods, or service-order administration. Response Instructions: Responses should not exceed five (5) pages, excluding a cover page and documentation supporting ISBEE or IEE status. Submit responses electronically to: Lara.Wood@bia.gov Subject Line: Sources Sought Response BIA Electrical Utility Operations and Maintenance Services Responses due: December 9, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. Eastern time. Phone calls will not be accepted. Attachment 1: Requirement Summary The anticipated requirement will support Government-owned electrical utility systems operated by the following BIA organizations: Colorado River Electrical Services (CR-ES) San Carlos Irrigation Project-Power Division (SCIP-PD) Truxton Canon Agency (TCA) Anticipated support may include: Low- and medium-voltage electrical system troubleshooting, diagnostics, maintenance, and repair Planned and emergency restoration activities Utility pole inspection, testing, transport, and replacement support Substation inspection, operation, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair Meter installation, troubleshooting, reading, and related services Switching support, outage response, and emergency call-out services Support in remote or geographically dispersed locations The contractor may be required to provide qualified personnel, supervision, transportation, specialized tools, equipment, vehicles, personal protective equipment, mobilization, and other resources necessary to perform assigned services. Work may be performed within the service areas of CR-ES, SCIP-PD, and TCA, including portions of Arizona and California. Locations include the Colorado River Indian Reservation, Gila River Indian Reservation, San Carlos Apache Reservation, and Havasupai Reservation. Certain locations are geographically remote and may have limited vehicle access. The Government anticipates a combination of planned work and emergency-response requirements. The final scope, contract structure, labor standards, service levels, and ordering procedures will be developed after considering market research results.

title: Z2DA--FY27 EHRM | 657-21-702JC EHRM Training And Administrative Space Construction - St Louis John Cochran
description: INTRODUCTION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting bids and subsequently awarding a single firm-fixed-price contract for the design-bid-build EHRM Training and Administrative Space Construction project at the St. Louis VA Health Care System (VAHCS) John Cochran campus located at 915 North Grand BLVD, St. Louis, MO 63106. PROJECT DESCRIPTION The VA Saint Louis Health Care System John Cochran Division requires a construction contractor to perform upgrades in support of the Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) program. The construction area is located on the first floor of Building 2 and includes both training and administrative spaces. This project includes the execution of Phases 2, 3, and 4 of the associated design plans. Phase 2 addresses the North Training Rooms (Rooms 139, 140, 141, 142), totaling approximately 2,000 square feet. Work includes upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes. Phase 3 addresses the South Training Rooms (Rooms 126, 127, 128), totaling approximately 1,800 square feet. Work includes upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes. Additionally, Phase 3 includes the renovation of a 130-square-foot breakroom, with new floor and wall finishes, casework, a new sink, and a cold-water tie-in for an ice machine. Phase 4 addresses multiple areas: renovation of an approximately 1,400-square-foot corridor with new floor and wall finishes; upgrades to two offices (approximately 150 square feet each) with upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes; and upgrades to an existing data closet, including new floor and wall finishes, installation of an additional server rack with associated equipment, and replacement of the existing mini-split HVAC unit. Note: Phase 1 is excluded from this scope, as it was completed under a separate contract. Note: All power and data drops originally indicated as floor-mounted shall now be wall-mounted, as shown on revised drawings EP101 and TN101. Installation must match these updated sheet details; no floor-mounted outlets are permitted. ADMINISTRATIVE The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bids (IFB) conducted in accordance with FAR part 14 and will be evaluated in accordance with the procedures listed in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Offers received from other than SDVOSB concerns will not be considered. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45.0 million. The solicitation will be issued in early to mid-October 2026. The period of performance is approximately 150 calendar days from the issuance of the notice to proceed. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $250,000 and $500,000. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to Amanda.Webster@va.gov. Telephone calls will not be accepted.

title: Lightning Tech Refresh
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposal. It shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to award a contract as a result of this request for information. The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), Naval Air Warfare Center Lakehurst NJ (NAWCADLKE) is requesting information from industry in order to identify airfield lighting manufacturers capable of producing airfield lighting to be integrated into the US Marine Corps Expeditionary Airfield (EAF) Lighting Systems Portfolio. NAVAIR is considering a battery powered Expeditionary Airfield Ground Lighting Enabling System to support US Marine Corps aviation operations. Broad industry participation is desired but NAVAIR is keenly interested in designs that are currently in production or near production. Material identified as Company Proprietary provided in response to this RFI will be treated as such by the Government. 1. PURPOSE: This notice is part of Government Market Research, a process for obtaining the latest information on the �art of the possible' from industry with respect to their current and near-term abilities. All company proprietary information contained in the response shall be separately marked. Any proprietary information contained in response to this request that is properly marked will be properly protected from unauthorized disclosure. The Government will not use proprietary information submitted from any one firm to establish the capability and requirements for any future systems acquisition so as to not inadvertently restrict competition. 2. OBJECTIVES: The objectives of this Request for Information (RFI) are to identify responsible sources and interested parties who have proven solutions that can meet or exceed EAF requirements; gather comprehensive technical performance, reliability, and maintainability data on available systems to inform internal strategy development for future procurements; and assess the current market for in-production or near-production battery-powered LED airfield lighting solutions, particularly those compatible with Night Vision Devices (NVDs) such as Night Vision Imaging System (NVIS). 3. BACKGROUND: The mission of the NAVAIR EAF program is to equip the US Marine Corps to support Naval Aviation with the flexibility and capability to rapidly deploy and establish survivable, self-sustaining airfields in austere, expeditionary operating environments. The EAF Concept is a shore-based, aviation weapons support system which permits deployment of landing force aircraft within effective range of ground forces. This concept allows for the construction of portable, reusable, forward-deployed airfields that can be assembled in a building block concept for the rapid introduction of air power. The EAF family of systems supports a myriad of airfield configurations, ranging in size and complexity from single-aircraft vertical take-off and landing sites, to short runways for tactical aircraft, to extended runways for heavy cargo lift, through the deployment of airfield surfacing systems, expeditionary arresting gear, airfield terminal guidance systems and airfield lighting and marking systems. 4. REQUIREMENTS: The Expeditionary Airfield Ground Lighting Enabling System shall be comprised of battery powered LED lighting components which are also NVIS compatible. If there are any test results available, including but not limited to those performed by third-party test facilities, please include with your response. Please address the areas of concern below for each product that are designed to meet the technical performance of any/all of the following light types: FAA L-861 Medium Intensity Runway Edge Light FAA L-861E Runway Threshold/End Light FAA L-861T Taxiway Edge Light FAA L-810 Obstruction Light Tactical/Quick deployable, user selectable color, light that have been designed and tested to the following: FAA L-860 FAA L-863 Photometric/Radiometric. Please describe the photometric and optical properties including the minimum average intensity, vertical and horizontal beam coverage. If there are multiple intensity steps, please provide the intensities at each of the steps. Please describe the radiometric and infrared (IR) properties, including Radiant intensity, average NVIS Class B Radiant Intensity (NRIb), and centroid wavelengths. If there are multiple IR intensity steps, please provide the intensities at each of the steps. Control: Please describe the control characteristics of the light fixture. Is there the ability to control the light output of each light at the light unit itself? Can the visible and IR intensities be controlled independent of each other? Can the light output both visible and IR simultaneously? Please describe how the light unit is controlled remotely. Can the visible and IR intensities be controlled independent of each other? Can the light output both visible and IR simultaneously? Is there the ability for the light to turn on and off automatically depending on ambient light conditions? How are the visible and IR intensities set? At what ambient light level will the fixture turn on? At what ambient light level will the fixture turn off? Electrical characteristics: How much power does the light fixture consume while on its highest intensity step? Please include data for both visible and IR output, plus all control and wireless electronics. How much power does the light fixture consume while in �standby� mode, where there is no light being emitted, only wireless and control electronics consume power? Battery: What chemistry does the battery utilize and what is the rated capacity? What is the run time of the light fixture at its highest output without any solar source for recharge? What is the runtime while the ambient temperature is -40F? +150F? Does the light remain at its set intensity until it reaches a low power cutoff? Does the light lower its output over time to extend run time? If so, please explain how this is accomplished. Please describe how the battery is charged from an external source, including physical connections and electrical demands. How long does it take to fully charge the battery, and what capacity does the battery charge to? What about when the ambient temperature is -40F? Are these values the results from testing, or theoretical? Solar: Does the light fixture have a self-contained photovoltaic/solar recharge capability? If so, what is the energy generated capacity? How many panels are used, and what is their orientation? Can the orientation be adjusted? What is the required solar irradiance needed to fully charge the battery? Is the light fixture capable of being recharged by a removable solar source? If so, please describe the removable solar module, including the physical interface to the light? Can the light still operate without being connected to solar? Also, what is the energy generated capacity? How many panels are used, and what is their orientation? Can the orientation be adjusted? What is the required solar irradiance needed to fully charge the battery? Installation: Please describe how the lighting fixtures are typically installed. Is there any frangibility in this mounting method? What are the final installed dimensions, including length, width, and height, of the lighting fixture after installing using all methods the light can be installed. Does the light fixture have the ability to operate from an external power source? If applicable, please describe this, including the physical interface connections, as well as the electrical requirements. Packaging, transportation, storage, and maintenance: Please describe how the components are packaged for transportation, shipping, and storage. What is the quantity of components? What ancillary equipment is provided in this package? Do the battery powered components have the ability to be charged while in storage? title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source access to online research and compliance and regulatory training provided by Biomedical Research Alliance of New York LLC (BRANY)
description: The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) intends to issue a sole source award. The Defense Health Agency (DHA) requires an institutional subscription to the Collaborative Institutional Training Initiative (CITI) Program to provide web-based research compliance and regulatory training to DHA personnel. The requirement includes 24/7 online access to training in areas such as Human Subjects Research, Good Clinical Practice, Information Privacy and Security, Animal Care and Use, Responsible Conduct of Research, Conflicts of Interest, and other applicable research protection and compliance topics. The subscription also provides user completion certificates, administrative/institutional access, and electronic transmission of training completion information to support DHA research oversight and protocol management requirements. Any firm that believes it can provide the stated capability as outlined above is invited to submit a written notification to the Contracting Office NLT 2PM ET on 4 December 2026. description: SAM.gov Special Notice: Notice of Intent to Award a Sole-Source Contract Notice ID: 693JF7-27-SN-0001 Notice Type: Special Notice (Intent to Sole Source) Agency: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Maritime Administration (MARAD) Contracting Office: Office of Acquisition, 1200 New Jersey Ave SE, Washington, DC 20590 NAICS Code: 488310: Port and Harbor Operations Response Due Date: December 9, 2026, 2:00 PM EST: 15 calendar days from posting per FAR 5.203(a) Point of Contact: Henry.Puppe@dot.gov Subject Notice of Intent to Award a Sole-Source Contract for Four-Vessel U.S. East Coast Ready Reserve Force (RRF) Layberth Services Description of Requirement The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Maritime Administration (MARAD), intends to award a sole-source contract to Fairwinds Landing (Piers L and N, Lambert�s Point, Norfolk, Virginia) pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1) and Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements.
