The contemplated period of performance consists of a one-year base period (January 1, 2027 � December 31, 2027). The vessels require secure waterfront berthing while undergoing reflagging, regulatory and classification inspections, certification, maintenance, repairs, and modernization prior to entering active RRF service. To meet MARAD�s minimum operational requirements, the layberth facility must provide: Immediate availability to accommodate all four (4) vessels beginning January 1, 2027, without requiring Government-funded capital modifications or construction. Direct open-ocean access with sufficient berth length, pier strength, and water depth/draft ([INSERT: specific minimum pier length and draft for the LMSRs]). Existing, operational shore power ([INSERT: voltage/amperage specs]), utilities, crane/heavy-lift accessibility, and dedicated MARSEC-compliant security guard services. title: C-17 Globemaster III Modular Approach Shoring System & Companion Flight Certified Tactical Shipping Containers
description: 1. PURPOSE & OPERATIONAL SCOPE The 911th Airlift Wing is conducting market research under FAR Part 10 to identify qualified commercial manufacturers and authorized suppliers capable of providing a reusable, modular, non-wood aircraft approach shoring system and companion flight-certified tactical storage containers engineered specifically for C-17 Globemaster III flight and cargo operations. Mission Need: Loading heavy tracked/wheeled vehicles and low-clearance trailers into the C-17 cargo compartment requires approach shoring to reduce the ramp crest angle and protect ramp toes. The wing is replacing legacy dimensional lumber wedges to: Eliminate Weight & Cube: Eliminate thousands of pounds of deadweight wood consuming payload and pallet space Ensure Phytosanitary Compliance: Eliminate dimensional lumber subject to international border quarantine (ISPM-15 and DoD Manual 4140.65-M) Prevent Flightline FOD: Eliminate splintering lumber, loose nails, and banding hazards adjacent to C-17 turbofan engines Accelerate Turnaround: Achieve full ground setup in under 15 minutes without specialized heavy equipment This announcement is for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or an Invitation for Bids (IFB). No contract will be awarded directly from this notice and the Government will not pay for any information submitted. 2. DRAFT SALIENT TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS Prospective commercial solutions must meet or exceed the following performance and physical parameters: Part A: Modular Approach Shoring System (Brand Name or Equal to DAMAS 26K) Air Transportability Certification (MANDATORY GATE): Quoted system must possess an active, written air transportability and cargo loading certification letter issued by AFLCMC/EZFC ATTLA (Air Transportability Test Loading Activity) authorizing internal flight carriage and roll-on/roll-off loading operations on C-17 aircraft (equivalent to ATTLA Memo # 2012.02.06.02 Rev 1) Because immediate operational availability is required, developmental systems requiring unperformed AFLCMC flight tests will not be considered Axle Load Ratings & Safety Factor: Single axle load rating: Minimum 26,000 lbs per axle Multi-axle rating (spaced > 48 inches): Minimum 20,000 lbs/axle (40,000 lbs tandem total) Multi-axle rating (spaced < or equal to 48 inches): Minimum 26,000 lbs combined axle loading Structural Safety Factor: Minimum 2:1 structural safety factor (components rated for no more than 50% of structural yield/failure strength) Airframe Floor Contact Pressure: Under maximum rated axle load, contact pressure exerted on the C-17 cargo floor, ramp, or ramp toes must not exceed (50 psi) Airframe Protection & FOD Control: All base surfaces coming into contact with the aircraft floor or cargo ramp (ground wedges, ramp pads, stand bases) must feature smooth, durable, vulcanized or bonded synthetic/rubber belting to prevent metal-to-metal scoring All structural locking pins, lynch pins, and retaining hardware must be permanently captive/tethered via aircraft-grade lanyards to eliminate flightline Foreign Object Damage (FOD) Elevation Geometry & Vehicle Clearance: Compatible with tracked, wheeled, and winched equipment with tire/wheel outer diameters of 24 inches or greater Configurable to ramp crest elevations of: 13 inches to 15 inches 20 inches to 24 inches 34 inches to 38 inches Incline lead-in ground wedges provide smooth transition from 0 to 4 inches Rapid manual assembly achievable in under 15 minutes by a 2�3 person crew without specialized material handling equipment Kit Composition (Bill of Materials per 1 Complete Kit): Two (2) Matched Ramp Runs, each consisting of: Two (2) Heavy-Duty Ramp Sections (94" L x 36" W x 4" H) Two (2) Lead-In Ground Wedge Assemblies (0" to 4" elevation) One (1) Low-Height Modular Support Stand (13" to 15" range) One (1) Medium-Height Modular Support Stand (20" to 24" range) One (1) High-Elevation Modular Support Stand (34" to 38" range) Full set of permanently tethered quick-connect locking pins One (1) Comprehensive Technical Operations & Inspection Manual detailing C-17 loading setups Manufacturing & Materials: 100% metal (structural aircraft-grade aluminum/steel) or composite build (strictly exempt from ISPM-15 wood quarantine) Welded in an American Welding Society (AWS) certified facility by AWS-certified welders Part B: Flight-Certified Tactical Shipping Container (Brand Name or Equal to Warrior Shipping Container) 463L Cargo Pallet & Ground Integration: Sized and engineered to fit two (2) complete containers side-by-side on a standard 463L cargo pallet while maintaining required 14 inch C-17 center aisleway clearance External dimensions fit inside a standard 8 foot commercial pickup truck bed with tailgate closed Tactical Flight Restraint Loads: Flight-certified to withstand C-17 tactical flight accelerations per MIL-STD-1791 without structural degradation: Forward: 3.0G | Aft: 1.5G | Lateral: 1.5G | Vertical Up: 2.0G | Vertical Down: 4.5G Deck Protection & Tie-Downs: Base bottom features bonded synthetic belting to eliminate parking shoring requirements (deck contact pressure (50 psi) Minimum eight (8) external heavy-duty tie-down brackets rated for standard USAF CGU-1/B (5,000 lb) straps Operational Handling & Identification: Four-way forklift pockets compatible with USAF 10K Standard, 10K AT, and 13K Adverse Terrain forklifts Dual access: Gas-assisted top lid and side-access doors to inventory and unpack shoring while secured to the pallet/floor Exterior riveted data plate with loadmaster rigging instructions and provision for machine-readable 2D Data Matrix IUID plate per DFARS 252.211-7003 3. CAPABILITY STATEMENT SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS Interested businesses capable of supplying these items are requested to provide a concise Capabilities Statement (maximum 5 to 8 pages, excluding ATTLA letters and commercial specification cut sheets) containing: 3.1. Business Profile & Socioeconomic Status Company Name, Address, Website, CAGE Code, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email) Business size status under NAICS 332312 (500 Employees): Indicate if your company qualifies as an SBA-Certified SDVOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), WOSB, SDB, or Large Business Manufacturer vs. Reseller Status: Indicate whether your firm is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized distributor. If a reseller, confirm compliance with FAR 19.505 (Nonmanufacturer Rule) 3.2. Airworthiness & Technical Capability ATTLA Certification: Provide official AFLCMC/EZFC ATTLA approval letter and tracking number for C-17 aircraft operations Technical Compliance Statement: Affirm compliance with the salient characteristics in Section 2 (axle ratings, loading, belting, captive hardware and AWS welding standards) Product Cut Sheets: Attach commercial drawings, dimensional specifications, and weight ratings for both ramp assemblies and containers 3.3. Commercial Market Data & Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) Non-binding ROM pricing for: One (1) Complete Modular Shoring Kit (as detailed in Section 2, Part A.6) One (1) Companion Flight-Certified Tactical Shipping Container (Section 2, Part B) Estimated FOB Destination freight delivery to Pittsburgh ARS (Coraopolis, PA 15108) Standard commercial manufacturing and delivery lead times for quantities of 1 to 3 systems Country of Origin / Buy American Act (DFARS 252.225-7001) compliance status Existing Federal contract vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS, DLA...), including contract numbers

title: Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels
description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Air and Marine Operations (AMO), anticipates issuing a solicitation for the design, construction, integration, testing, delivery, and associated logistics support of enclosed-cabin Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels (IPVs), including compatible trailers, for use by the U.S. Border Patrol (USBP). The anticipated requirement includes two vessel categories: Patrol Boat-Small (PC1): Vessels 25 feet in length or less, designed for operation in shallow and obstructed waterways, including riverine environments. Patrol Boat-Medium (PC2): Vessels at least 25 feet and no more than 29 feet in length, designed for operation in rougher open-water, coastal, Great Lakes, and other inshore environments. The anticipated contract may provide for the procurement of up to 117 Class 4 IPVs, including up to 31 PC1 vessels and up to 86 PC2 vessels. Each vessel will include a compatible trailer. Actual quantities and ordering requirements will be established in the solicitation and any resulting contract or orders. The contractor will be responsible for providing vessels that meet the Government�s performance requirements. Anticipated contractor responsibilities include program management; vessel design, engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, and integration; contractor-furnished equipment; quality control; configuration management; testing; technical data, manuals, drawings, and provisioning data; warranty support; delivery; and operator and maintenance familiarization training. REQUIREMENT & SCOPE OF WORK This is a non-personal services Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to provide yearly ISO 17025-accredited calibration and necessary evaluation and repair services for Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (N4523A) Product Line Combat Systems (Shop 67) owned Government Furnished Equipment (GFE). The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and non-personal services necessary to bring the GFE up to OEM specifications in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS). Equipment Requiring Service: Keysight FieldFox 50 GHz Microwave Analyzers, Model N9952A Keysight Economy Mechanical Calibration Kits, Model 85563A Keysight FieldFox RF Vector Network Analyzers, Model N9923A Performance Scope: Initial Task Order (to be awarded immediately upon IDIQ award): Model N9952A (4 EA) Model 85563A (3 EA) Model N9923A (2 EA) Evaluation and Repair services (as needed) Five-Year IDIQ Estimated Known Requirements: Model N9952A (8 EA per year) Model 85563A (8 EA per year) Model N9923A (2 EA per year) Evaluation and Repair services (as needed) Technical Calibration Requirements: ISO 17025-accredited calibration providing a minimum 4:1 Test Uncertainty Ratio (TUR) or ?2% Probability of False Accept (PFA). The calibration laboratory must be accredited by a US-based accrediting body covering the specific measurement parameters, ranges, and physical facility performing the work. Traceability to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) with complete calibration certificates and test data returned with each serialized unit. SOLE SOURCE JUSTIFICATION SUMMARY OEM Status & Directive Keysight Technologies Inc. (CAGE: 7ZXR5) is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the FieldFox Analyzers and Calibration Kits. The NAVSEA Test, Measurement, and Diagnostic Equipment / Technical Warrant Holder (NAVSEA TAMS) has directed that these combat system assets be sent directly to the OEM for calibration and repair. Proprietary Software & Parts The required calibration, diagnostic evaluation, alignment, and repair services require Keysight OEM-proprietary diagnostic software, alignment algorithms, test fixtures, and OEM replacement parts. Keysight Technologies does not license or authorize outside third-party vendors for these proprietary calibration and maintenance protocols. Technical Capability Required calibration and repairs exceed the internal capabilities of Navy METCAL. Keysight Technologies is the sole provider of factory-recommended upgrades, proprietary software updates, factory-authorized training, and escalation services to resolve hardware/firmware issues up to OEM operational specifications. title: NOI for Inpatient Pharmacy Pyxis Carousel
description: The Carousel will provide the pharmacy with an advanced automated medication storage and retrieval system designed to improve operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, and medication availability. By securely organizing and dispensing medications, the system reduces manual handling, minimizes medication errors, and streamlines workflow for pharmacy staff. This technology will enhance the pharmacy�s ability to manage inventory in real time, optimize storage capacity, and ensure timely access to medications ultimately supporting improved patient safety and overall pharmacy performance. The inpatient pharmacy�s outdated manual storage and distribution systems limit efficiency and increase the risk of medication errors. Other VA inpatient pharmacies have improved workflow, security, and inventory accuracy by implementing the Carousel. Given our high inpatient volume, upgrading to Carousel is essential for timely and accurate medication delivery, compliance with standards, and patient safety.
